scripts.ready: vp check && vp run -r test && vp run -r build
scripts.dev:frontend: vp run --filter @lhs-vsts/machine build && vp run frontend#dev
scripts.dev:backend: vp run --filter @lhs-vsts/machine build && vp run backend#start:dev
scripts.build:docker: pnpm --filter @lhs-vsts/machine build && pnpm --filter frontend build && mkdir -p apps/backend/public && rm -rf apps/backend/public/* && cp -a apps/frontend/dist/. apps/backend/public/ && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.test:e2e:api: vp run --filter @lhs-vsts/machine build && vp run backend#test:e2e
scripts.test:cov: vp run --filter @lhs-vsts/machine test:cov && vp run backend#test:cov && vp run frontend#test:cov
